teaching_language: Fully English-taught bachelor's degree (Corso di laurea in L-14 Transnational and European Legal Studies; the Italian-language version of the site labels it 'L-14', course delivered in English)
academic_requirements: Secondary school diploma (or other qualification obtained abroad suitable for access to an equivalent university course), or enrolment in the final year of secondary school pending the final exam. Foreign qualifications are eligible if obtained after attendance of the last two years of the foreign education system, allow access to a similar course of study in the country of origin, and were obtained after 12 years of schooling. University-wide (international.unime.it) Bachelor's requirements also apply: high school diploma after 12 years of education (provisional certificate accepted if not yet issued; if diploma is under 12 years, an academic certificate of first-year university exams passed, or a Foundation Programme completion certificate, is required), plus a University Entrance Exam Certificate if required by the applicant's national education system.
language_requirements: English knowledge at least CEFR B2 is required to enrol. Applicants may satisfy this via: (a) an international English certificate recognised by MIUR-accredited certifying bodies, (b) declaring themselves native English speakers, or (c) self-certifying citizenship/residence in a country where English is the official language. University-wide accepted certificates (international.unime.it): IELTS 5.5+, TOEFL iBT 72+, Cambridge English B2 First+, PTE General Level 3 (B2)+, PTE Academic 59+ (valid up to two years from test date). Exemptions apply for native speakers from listed English-speaking countries/territories, holders of a degree taught entirely in English from those countries, IB Diploma holders (English-medium), and takers of a standardised English-language admission test.
entry_exam_or_test: Entrance skills/basic-knowledge test required of all first-time enrollees: administered via the CISIA TOLC system, specifically the English TOLC-E (TOLC-SU test guide also referenced), as UNIME is a member of the CISIA consortium. No further programme-specific selection test beyond this basic-knowledge check is described on the official pages.
required_documents: High school diploma obtained after 12 years of education (or official provisional Course Completion Certificate if not yet issued)
If diploma is less than 12 years: academic certificate of passed first-year university exams, or Foundation Programme completion certificate
University Entrance Exam Certificate, if required by the national education system of the applicant's country
English language certificate (CEFR B2) or equivalent exemption declaration
CISIA TOLC-E (English) test result / registration for the basic-knowledge test
application_deadline_eu: For EU / No-Visa applicants (Italians with foreign qualification, EU and EU-equivalent candidates), UNIME's 2026/2027 intake uses the 6th Call - No Visa Applicants: from 1 July 2026 (00:01 CEST) to 20 November 2026 (23:59 CET). This programme (English-taught bachelor's) is included in this call. [uncertain: whether TELS has any separate/earlier EU deadline of its own beyond the university-wide call]
application_deadline_non_eu: Non-EU (Study VISA applicant) candidates may apply in any of three sequential rounds, each covering English-taught & Italian-taught Bachelor's and Master's Degrees: 1st Call – Early Bird: 24 November 2025 (00:01 CET) to 22 December 2025 (23:59 CET); 2nd Call - Visa Applicants: 1 February 2026 (00:01 CET) to 31 March 2026 (23:59 CEST); 3rd Call - Visa Applicants: 13 April 2026 (00:01 CEST) to 10 May 2026 (23:59 CEST). A non-refundable EUR 30.00 application fee is due (covers up to two applications). Applications for English-taught programmes go through the UniME Application Portal; visa applicants must also register on the Universitaly portal. For a.y. 2026/2027 the Universitaly pre-enrolment deadline is 1 September 2026.
